title: Finite local systems after forgetting cyclic module coefficients
statement: Let $Y$ be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $n\geq1$ and $M$ a sheaf valued in modules over $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf Z/n)$ on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $G$ be its underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then $G$ is locally constant as an abelian sheaf [def-constructible-locally-constant] with finite stalks at every algebraically closed geometric point [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] if and only if there is an etale trivializing cover for $M$ with finite constant module values [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The conclusion concerns a single scheme, not a stratification; it asserts no module lift or uniqueness for arbitrary abelian sheaves.

proof.text: Given a finite module trivialization, forget it to an abelian trivialization. Constant module sheaves have the corresponding constant abelian sheaves underneath. Lift every geometric point to a member of the cover and identify its stalk with the finite constant value. This proves local constancy and finite abelian stalks.

Given an abelian trivialization with finite stalks, discard empty cover members. Choose a geometric point on each remaining member. Its constant abelian value is isomorphic to the finite stalk, so is finite and annihilated by n. Give this value its canonical cyclic-module structure. Constants commute with forgetting and every additive map between cyclic modules is linear, so the trivialization lifts to a module isomorphism. These isomorphisms supply the LocallyConstantDatum and its finite constant values. For n=1 all values are zero. Empty schemes use the empty cover.

theorem finite_local_cyclic_module_forget_iff {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (M : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))) :
    let G := (sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M
    (IsLocallyConstantSheaf G ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y),
        Finite (((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)) ↔
    ∃ d : LocallyConstantDatum M, ∀ i : d.cover.I₀,
      ∃ A : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)), Finite A ∧
        Nonempty ((M.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅
          (constantSheaf (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))).obj A)
